MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The memory card fits my repeated use of removable storage, provided my devices support its capacity; the portable hard drive offers a useful next step for backing up those files.",
    "The USB extension cable complements my card reader and other USB accessories by making them easier to connect when ports are hard to reach."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Photography tripods and memory cards do not mean I need surveillance cameras; I use those accessories for taking pictures, which is a different purpose from monitoring my home.",
    "The smart speakers, lighting kit, and earbuds do not solve a need evident in my recent purchases. The internal SSD also assumes a computer upgrade project I have not shown interest in.",
    "A newer Fire 7 is not a compelling next purchase when I already have one and its accessories, and the streaming stick offers no clear benefit for my current playback needs."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Owning a Fire tablet seems to have been taken as interest in more Amazon devices, even though my purchases mainly show me equipping devices I already own.",
    "My interest in memory cards seems to have been stretched into interest in any storage hardware, without distinguishing convenient file backup from installing an internal computer drive."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated purchases of cables, mounts, readers, cases, and power accessories suggest that making existing equipment more useful matters to me.",
    "Compatibility and a concrete use matter: I would check whether the larger memory card works with my devices, and I need a clear reason before replacing equipment I already own."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognize my storage and accessory needs but stretch them too far into unrelated electronics and unnecessary device replacements."
}
